visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit, modern indoor plaza with high glass windows overlooking a city skyline. A man and a woman are seated on a light-colored, curved wooden bench under a large tan patio umbrella. The woman wears a white cap and a white graphic t-shirt with a green flower, holding a mint-green ice cream cone. The man wears a white cap and a beige t-shirt, holding a cold drink in a clear plastic cup. A young boy in a grey and black raglan shirt sits next to them, gazing intently at the ice cream while the adults talk. (2) As the parents face each other in conversation, the boy leans his head toward the ice cream. He successfully licks the top of the scoop while his mother is distracted, and a small '+1' graphic and a score counter appear on screen. The boy pulls back quickly, looking at the camera with a playful and secretive expression, covering his mouth with his hands. The background shows blurred figures of other mall patrons and colorful mural art. (3) Over the next several moments, the boy makes repeated attempts to lick the ice cream. In some instances, the woman inadvertently moves the cone away just as he leans in, leading to 'miss' graphics and 'OH NO' text overlays. The boy's facial expressions alternate between intense focus, disappointment during misses, and joyful dancing with arm-waving when he succeeds. The camera follows his small movements with a steady, eyes-level perspective. (4) The woman eventually notices the boy's antics and brings the ice cream closer to him. In a tight medium shot, the boy takes a large, enthusiastic bite of the cone, producing a visible crunch. The parents erupt into laughter, looking down at the child affectionately. The video concludes with a close-up of the boy's smiling face as he looks directly into the lens, followed by a final score summary overlay on a blurred background.
